segments.name: Consulting services
segments.description: Provides labor and corporate consulting to labor unions and companies to foster constructive employment relationships and resolve labor disputes.
segments.evidence: In consulting services, we provide consulting services to both labor unions and companies to enable constructive resolution of labor issues.

segments.name: Health services
segments.description: Operates directly owned osteopathic clinics and an osteopathic beauty salon in Japan to alleviate physical ailments primarily created by work-related stress.
segments.evidence: In the health segment, we have two health services, osteopathic clinics and osteopathic beauty salons.

revenueModel.text: Labor unions and companies pay consulting fees, while individual customers pay for treatments at directly operated osteopathic clinics and beauty salons.
revenueModel.evidence: We provide consulting services to labor unions, as well as to companies wishing to build constructive relationships with labor unions.
